scripts.install:all: npm install && (cd client && npm install) && (cd admin && npm install) && (cd backend && bundle install)
scripts.dev:worker: cd backend && bundle exec rake solid_queue:start
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors "bold.cyan,bold.green,bold.magenta,bold.yellow" --names "backend,worker,client,admin" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
